buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (1) Bulk order will be placed on the manufacturer having valid BIS License for tendered item IS:-408:1981 REAFFIRMED-2004 or latest OR having satisfactory supply performance of at least 20% of the tender/bid qt y of tendered item to any Railways or any Govt. organization cumulatively in last 3 years from the date of closing of the GeM bid including current year. Firm must upload documentary evidence regarding the past successful supply performance like copies of Receipt Note/CRN, completion report etc. along with the offer without which the offer shall be liable to be rejected. Other offers with successful supply performance of te ndered item but not meeting the minimum 20% limit shall be consider for developmental order subject to maximum 20% of net procurable qty. (2). Only OEM or authorized dealers are eligible to participate in this tender. Authorized dealers shall partic ipate with valid tender specific authorization of OEM, failing which offer shall be summarily rejected. (3) Firm should submit valid pollution control and fire protection certificate issued from authorized agency, failing which offer shall be summarily rejected. (4).Bidder must upload the license copy ( Manufacturing license) to carry out business of processing of ten dered item/ Lubricating Oil under the provision of Lubricating Oils and Greases ( Processing , Supply & dist ribution regulation ) order 1987 of Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, failing which offer shall be summ arily rejected. (5) Trader/Authorized Dealer should mention name of Manufacturer, make and complete address in their b id for inspection of material at OEM works, no other work will be considered for inspection other than OEM premise. (6) In a tender, either the authorized agent/dealer on behalf of the Principal/OEM or the Principal/OEM itself can bid, but both cannot bid simultaneously for the same item in the same tender and such bids will be su mmarily rejected. (7).Further, against a particular tender, one Principal/OEM should not issue Tender Specific Authorization t o more than one agent/ dealer. Such offers will be treated as ambiguous offers, the bidder(s) or their Princi pal/OEM will have no right to lodge any claim and such bids will be summarily rejected. (8) If an authorized agent/dealer submits bid on behalf of a Principal/OEM, the same agent/dealer shall not submit a bid on behalf of another Principal/OEM in the same tender for the same item/product and such bid s will be summarily rejected. (9) In case tenderer participate as an authorized agent, then the performance as required above shall be t hat of the principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen that the agent has credentials of past supply f or a different Principal but this will not be considered as performance for placing bulk order in case of chan ge of Principal .
